visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can a completely unprepared dad master a high-stakes morning routine when his daughter's hair refuses to cooperate?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: When a father unexpectedly has to take over styling his young daughter Zuri's hair before a special occasion, an everyday routine turns into an unruly challenge against locks that have a mind of their own.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, tender, and effortlessly fast, offering an easy burst of family comedy.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: At seven lively minutes, this animated family comedy delivers genuine father-daughter warmth and brisk comic timing with zero viewing friction.
